text_block_list.text: One day, as the Junior Class was finally drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss, that one felt great!
What'd ya think!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, hit the target time again!
Yeah, I hit my target time again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis, that one felt great!
What do you think!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, hit the target time again!
Yeah, I hit my target time again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
Things have been goin' pretty damn good lately!

――In fact, Inari One has grown beyond my expectations
through the Junior Class. With this, she should be able
to take on even greater challenges next year...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Boss.
Mind if we chat for a bit while we take a break?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Boss Lady.
Mind if we chat for a bit while we take a break?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. It’s almost the Classic Class, after all.
...There's something I wanna consult you about.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—All through the Junior Class, I was thinkin' about it.
What I gotta do to become someone so big that nobody can ignore me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And so, what I came up with in my own way—
was the word "The Top."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you stand at the very top, number one, the absolute strongest, then everyone's forced to look up to you whether they like it or not.
...Ain't that right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's why from now on, my goal...
is gonna be 'standing at the top'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And not just any "top."
Both the NAR and the JRA! I'm aiming for the top in both!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Having grown up in the regionals before transferring to the Central,
I reckon this is a huge goal only Lady Inari can achieve, but—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What do you think?
choice_data_list: I think that sounds incredibly fun...!

text_block_list.text:
"The definition of 'the top' or 'the strongest' differs from person to person.
However..."
The goal Inari One set is so very like her. That unique charm of hers should be more than worthy of the public's attention...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's a relief then!
Though, the tricky part starts from here—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm the one who said it, but...
what does it actually mean in practice to stand at the 'top' of both the Regional and Central circuits?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't think it's just about winning a bunch of races... it just kinda doesn't click with me, y'know?
choice_data_list: What about something like this? For instance—
How about something like this? For example—

text_block_list.text:
If Inari One conquers the Oi Racecourse GⅠ Tokyo Daishoten in her Classic year,
and continues to produce results in Central GⅠs during her Senior year—

—What if we could win
the highest honor of all,
the title of 'Umamusume of the Year'?

"Isn't that proof... of the 'summit' that
only Inari One—raised in the regional circuit
and honing her skills at Tracen—could reach?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —This is awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I love it!
Now that's a flashy "peak" that truly screams
"Inari One is here!", ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—It's settled.
I'm gonna conquer the NAR circuit,
and then take 'Umamusume of the Year'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, that's the goal I'm aiming for,
my very own—"pinnacle"!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled,
our first goal is the Tokyo Daishoten!

"The next Tokyo Daishoten isn't until the end of next year.
Before then, I want to gain some actual race experience
at Oi Racecourse...!"
choice_data_list: Let's run in the "Japan Dirt Derby".

text_block_list.text:
"The Japan Dirt Derby is the premier dirt race for the Classic class.
It should serve as the perfect mid-term goal heading into the end of the year."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's where we test our strength.
Though of course, I'm aiming for the "top"
at the Japan Dirt Derby too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aaaaargh! I'm getting all fired up!!

Aiming for the "top"—
the Classic year was about to begin!
